The NVX-204 trial tested peloxatril against a placebo in 480 adults with chronic migraine, with 240 participants in each arm (E1, E2). In the peloxatril arm, 96 participants had at least a 50% reduction in monthly migraine days, yielding a responder rate of 40% (96/240) (E3, E2). In the placebo arm, 60 participants met the same threshold, for a responder rate of 25% (60/240) (E4, E2). The absolute difference between the two arms is 15 percentage points.

Answer: The responder rate was 40% for the peloxatril arm and 25% for the placebo arm, with an absolute difference of 15 percentage points.
